list.title: Diiwaangelinta
list.empty: Ma jiro diiwaangelin u dhigma filtarradan.

override.title: Admin Dulmi
override.hint: Burburinta had iyo jeer waxay la socotaa aqoonsiga maamulahaaga iyo sababta - waligaa ha aamusin.
override.cancelBookingHint: Burinta waxay calaamadinaysaa ballan-qaadkii iyo komishankeedii sidii la tirtiray, waxay ku soo celinaysaa lahaanshaha hawlgalka lammaanaha, waxayna u ogolaataa wax-dhisuhu inuu mar kale buug-gudbiyo.
override.cancelBookingConfirm: Jooji ballan-qaadkan? Guddigeedii sidoo kale waa la joojiyay. Tani waxay ku qoran tahay magacaaga iyo sababta.

detail.disputeOpen: Muranka lahaanshaha ayaa u furan macmiilkan - lammaane kale ayaa sheegaya in ay iyagu leeyihiin. Waxaa lagu go'aamiyaa bogga Khilaafaadka.

cancellation.title: Boos-dhigista waa la joojiyay
cancellation.hint: Ballan-qaadkii iyo guddigeedii waa la joojiyay; lahaanshaha hawlfulintu waxay la soo noqotay lamaanaha, dhisuhuna mar kale ayuu ballansan karaa hogaankan.

disputes.title: Muranka lahaanshaha
disputes.hint: Shuraakada loo diiday diwaangelintiisa nuqul ahaan waxay ku murmi karaan cidda iska leh. Dib u eeg labada dhinac oo go'aanso.
disputes.empty: Wax khilaaf ah ma jiro heerkan

detail.title: Muranka {{id}}
detail.heldMissing: Diiwaangelinta la qabtay waa la heli waayay.
detail.noteRequired: Qor qoraal si aad u go'aansato.
detail.upholdEffect: {{holder}} waxa uu ilaaliyaa macmiilka. Khilaafku wuu xidhan yahay, wax kale oo iska beddelaya ma jiraan.
detail.overturnEffect: Ilaalinta nuqulka ah ee {{holder}} way dhammaatay hadda oo macmiilku waxa uu u diiwaangashan yahay {{partner}} sidii diiwaangelin cusub.
detail.heldBookedHelp: Macmiilkan waxa lagu ballansan yahay milkiilaha hadda. Baaji ballan-qaadkaas marka hore (Maamulka Ka-hortagga diiwaangelinta), ka dibna beddel:
